description: cargo fmt --check reports two formatting diffs: (1) pkix-chain/src/lib.rs: method-call chain for check_revocation_against_anchor split across two lines — rustfmt wants it on one line. (2) pkix-chain/tests/e2e.rs: use pkix_chain::{...} import should be wrapped. Fix: run 'cargo fmt --all' and commit the result.
title: cargo fmt fails on pkix-chain/src/lib.rs and pkix-chain/tests/e2e.rs
